entities.name: Median Empire
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Median Empire, a political institution in Iran during Median and Achaemenid Empires (728 BCE–550 BCE). Led to the emergence of Medes and Babylonians sack Nineveh, ending the Assyrian Empire and Cyrus the Great.
